task.description: Diagnose TC-SCH-02-02 (skipped_locked==0) and TC-SCH-02-03 (no error surfaced) failures in scheduler pollDueTimers
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified for both blocks
Design artifact with rationale, fix plan, AC, and risk analysis written to src/design/

result.summary: Diagnosed both blocks. Root causes: (1) processNextDueTimer conflates 'no due timers' with 'all due timers locked' — both yield empty SKIP LOCKED result and current code returns .none. (2) pollDueTimers fire-path failure handling returns .none instead of propagating SchedulerError.TransactionFailed. Design written to src/design/iss-0618-scheduler-poll-failure-surfacing.md. Both fixes touch src/scheduler/scheduler.zig only.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER (WF-03 Step 2) for design artifact refinement (validator handoff)
